check.description: Evaluate and build flake checks without modifying flake.lock.

project.description: Working directory containing the source checkout; defaults to the current directory. Default: ".".

runDir.description: Fresh directory for this invocation’s execution report and task logs; must not already exist.

executable.description: Native CLI executable name or absolute path; defaults to this operation’s tool.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum task duration in milliseconds; defaults to 900000. Default: 900000.

artifacts.description: Output artifacts to collect as NAME=PATH entries; names must be unique.

flake.description: Local flake path or reference to inspect; defaults to the selected project checkout. Default: ".".

project.description: Working directory containing the source checkout; defaults to the current directory. Default: ".".

runDir.description: Fresh directory for this invocation’s execution report and task logs; must not already exist.

executable.description: Native CLI executable name or absolute path; defaults to this operation’s tool.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum task duration in milliseconds; defaults to 900000. Default: 900000.

artifacts.description: Output artifacts to collect as NAME=PATH entries; names must be unique.

name.description: FlakeHub flake name as OWNER/REPOSITORY; no repository name is hardcoded.

visibility.description: Flake visibility: public, unlisted, or private. Default: "public". Allowed values: public, unlisted, private.

flakestry.description: Publish locked flake metadata and outputs to Flakestry using GitHub OIDC.

project.description: Working directory containing the source checkout; defaults to the current directory. Default: ".".

runDir.description: Fresh directory for this invocation’s execution report and task logs; must not already exist.

executable.description: Native CLI executable name or absolute path; defaults to this operation’s tool.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum task duration in milliseconds; defaults to 900000. Default: 900000.

artifacts.description: Output artifacts to collect as NAME=PATH entries; names must be unique.

version.description: Release version or tag to publish, such as v1.2.3.

ref.description: Git commit SHA corresponding to the selected release and checkout.

readme.description: Repository-relative README filename used by the Flakestry registry. Default: "README.md".

url.description: HTTPS Flakestry registry origin; also used as the GitHub OIDC audience. Default: "https://flakestry.dev".

ignoreConflicts.description: Treat HTTP 409 for an existing release as success; other HTTP errors still fail. Default: false.
